meta.name: add-whatsapp
meta.description: Add WhatsApp channel via native Baileys adapter. Direct connection — no Chat SDK bridge. Uses QR code or pairing code for authentication.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 接入 WhatsApp 渠道,直接收发消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发需要与 WhatsApp 收发消息的应用或机器人.
copy.tagline_en: Connect WhatsApp channel for direct messaging
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building an app or bot that needs to send and receive WhatsApp messages.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能一步步为 NanoClaw 接入 WhatsApp：从 channels 分支复制并注册适配器，安装依赖，构建测试，再引导你用手机扫二维码或输配对码完成登录。若你打算用个人号码，会先警告封号风险并经你确认才继续；最后把模式和助手名写入 .env。
howto.when: 当你说要添加 WhatsApp 通道、接入 WhatsApp 或把 NanoClaw 连上 WhatsApp 时触发。它会先问用专用还是共享号码；若选共享会显示风险警告，只有明确继续才往下装。

say.text: 给我的 NanoClaw 添加 WhatsApp
say.note: Claude 会开始技能流程，先问号码类型。
以 dedicated 模式进行，跳过共享号码警告。

say.text: 用配对码方式连接手机
say.note: 选择 pairing-code 认证，需你输入手机号。

howto.what_en: Lets Claude add a WhatsApp channel to NanoClaw: copy & register the adapter, install deps, build/test, then auth via QR or pairing code. If sharing your number, it warns about bans and needs explicit ok before continuing; writes mode & assistant name to .env.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add WhatsApp, hook up WhatsApp, or connect NanoClaw to WhatsApp. It first asks dedicated vs shared number; if shared, it shows the risk warning and proceeds only after you explicitly continue.

say_en.note: Claude starts the skill and asks about number type.
Proceeds as dedicated-mode install, no shared-number warning.
Chooses the pairing-code auth method; you'll enter your phone number.
